title: Orange and ricotta pancakes with strawberries

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or basic staple: flour, eggs, milk, ricotta, butter, fruit, honey and natural yoghurt.

supermarket.reason: Oranges, strawberries, ricotta and the rest are everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, fish slice, grater, whisk, bowls and a jug, and the techniques are simple drop pancakes and peeling oranges.

works.reason: 175g flour with 250g ricotta, 3 eggs and 150ml milk makes a thick batter for about 16 small pancakes, a sensible four portions, and the medium heat and timings will cook them through.

honest_times.reason: Zesting and peeling the oranges, hulling the strawberries, mixing, then frying four or five batches fits within 30 minutes hands-on and 35 in total.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient is used in the steps under its true name, and no unlisted food appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: The first strawberries and the last Spanish oranges are both on the fruit in early May, and the fruit is the point of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, friendly and in British English, with useful cues such as bubbles on top and a golden underside.

hearty_healthy.reason: The ricotta, eggs, yoghurt and plenty of fruit make a proper breakfast, and the added sugar is modest.
